✨ homelable | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Visualizing and monitoring self-hosted homelab infrastructure.
✨ Key Features: • Self-hosted infrastructure visualization • Network, Zigbee, Z-Wave scanning • Live status monitoring • Interactive network diagrams • Device documentation integration
📖 Summary: Homelable is a self-hosted infrastructure visualization tool that scans and monitors your homelab network. It generates interactive network diagrams, provides live status updates, and integrates device documentation directly into the visualization.
